description: Instalaciones de protección civil is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. In this dataset appears the list of centers and facilities dedicated to civil protection. The dataset is sorted numerically by its ascending value. The data have been obtained from the Survey of Infrastructure and Local Equipment, in its 2024 phase. Coverage: Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. The portal shows the English title as "Civil protection facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. Its keywords include seguridad ciudadana, protección civil, seguridad pública, geolocalizado. The listing shows 5 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
